purpose: FAQ retrieval, RAG, and customer-support agent knowledge base

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the Power Plan Family Group feature?
faqs.answer: This feature is available for Mobile Postpaid customers who are on eligible Power Plan packages (Power Plan 2100 / 3500).

faqs.question: What are the available Family group options?
faqs.answer: Power Plan 2100 supports up to 2 supplementary connections and a maximum group size of 3. Power Plan 3500 supports up to 4 supplementary connections and a maximum group size of 5. Available combinations are: Family of 2 = primary member + 1 supplementary member; Family of 3 = primary member + 2 supplementary members; Family of 4 = Power Plan 3500 primary member + 3 supplementary members; Family of 5 = Power Plan 3500 primary member + 4 supplementary members.

faqs.question: What benefits do supplementary members receive?
faqs.answer: Supplementary members will be assigned a special Rs. 800 + tax package that includes unlimited any-net voice, 1000 any-net SMS, and 15GB anytime data. The 15GB is added to the group's sharable data bucket.

faqs.question: Can I share data within the group?
faqs.answer: Yes. The group's sharable data includes the primary member's anytime quota plus 15GB from each supplementary connection.

faqs.question: How do I add members to my Family Group?
faqs.answer: Both primary and supplementary members must be on the same NIC and have the same billing cycle. Supplementary members will be automatically migrated to the Rs. 800 + tax plan upon successful addition.

faqs.question: What happens if a supplementary member is removed?
faqs.answer: Once removed, the supplementary number is migrated to the Rs. 900 + tax Blaster plan and their 15GB group data allocation will be revoked.

faqs.question: Can I change the primary member or their package after creating the group?
faqs.answer: No. Once a group is created, the primary member and package cannot be changed unless the group is dissolved.

faqs.question: What happens if a connection is temporarily disconnected?
faqs.answer: Both primary and supplementary members must reconnect their numbers before proceeding with group creation or changes.

faqs.question: Can a number be part of another sharing group at the same time?
faqs.answer: No. A member must leave any existing data share group before joining or creating a Power Plan Family Group.

faqs.question: When is the 15GB data allocated and how long is it valid?
faqs.answer: 15GB is added only after the group is successfully created and is valid for 30 days. It renews with each billing cycle.

faq_groups.title: Power Plan Friend Circle FAQs

faqs.question: Who is eligible to create or join a Friend Circle?
faqs.answer: Any customer on one of the eligible Power Plan packages: Power Plan 1300, Power Plan 2100, or Power Plan 3500.

faqs.question: What benefits do Primary and Supplementary members receive?
faqs.answer: Primary Member: 10GB bonus data monthly and a 10% Power Plan rental discount each month. Supplementary Members: a 10% Power Plan rental discount each month.

faqs.question: When are benefits applied?
faqs.answer: Benefits are allocated automatically once two supplementary members have been successfully added and the group is created.

faqs.question: Can I remove a member or delete the group?
faqs.answer: Yes. The primary member can remove any supplementary member via the MyDialog App. Once one member is removed, the group is deleted and all benefits end.

faqs.question: What happens if a member's connection is disconnected?
faqs.answer: All group benefits are removed immediately. When the disconnected member reconnects, benefits resume from the time of reconnection.

faqs.question: Can I change my package after forming a Friend Circle?
faqs.answer: Package changes to non-eligible plans are restricted while any members remain in the Friend Circle. Postpaid-to-prepaid conversions are also prohibited. Package changes are allowed between eligible packages.

faqs.question: How often can the 10GB bonus data be awarded?
faqs.answer: The 10GB bonus is a one-time offer per primary member. Removing and re-adding members or forming new groups will not trigger additional bonuses. For the primary user, the 10GB bonus data is valid for 30 days and will be renewed as long as the group remains active.

faq_groups.intro: An exclusive group feature available for Dialog Power Plan customers. Retail customers only.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for Dialog Fibre?
faqs.answer: All retail customers are eligible for Dialog Fibre packages based on coverage.

faqs.question: How do I sign up for a Dialog Fibre package?
faqs.answer: You can sign up by emailing service@dialog.lk, speaking to a member of staff at a Dialog outlet, or calling 0117100200.

faqs.question: How do I check my fibre quota?
faqs.answer: Your quota can be monitored using the MyDialog App.

faqs.question: How do I change my existing Dialog Fibre package?
faqs.answer: You can request a change by emailing service@dialog.lk, speaking to a member of staff at a Dialog outlet, or calling 0117100200.

faqs.question: Can I use my Dialog Club Vision discount when signing up for Dialog Fibre?
faqs.answer: Yes. The discount percentage varies depending on the category of your membership.

faqs.question: What is Dialog's Fair Usage Policy?
faqs.answer: Dialog's Fair Usage Policy is intended to maintain service quality and performance for all users. The policy automatically restricts internet speeds once certain data usage limits are reached.

faqs.question: Will I still be able to use data after I have exceeded the monthly Fair Usage limit?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Fair Usage Policy reduces speeds to 5 Mbps. This speed is sufficient for general web browsing and social media, but heavy activities such as streaming and downloads may be affected.

faqs.question: Is there a deadline to collect my pre-ordered Air Fibre device?
faqs.answer: The collection deadline for pre-ordered Dialog Air Fibre devices ended on 25 August 2026. Customers who did not collect their device by the deadline will receive an automatic refund of the Rs. 2,490 advance payment to the original account or card used for payment. Refunds will be processed by 25 September 2026. The Rs. 2,500 Early Bird Discount expired on 25 August 2026 and is no longer applicable.

faqs.question: What is the process to collect my Air Fibre pre-ordered device?
faqs.answer: Step 1: Visit the selected Dialog Experience Centre, where coverage will be verified and available Air Fibre packages will be explained. After selecting a package, make the balance payment and confirm the order. Step 2: Once the order is confirmed, a technical team will schedule a premises visit within 48 hours to identify the optimal router location and assess service performance. If coverage is sufficient, installation and activation will proceed. If the technical assessment determines that 5G coverage is insufficient, installation will not proceed and the full payment will be refunded within 7 working days.

faqs.question: Why can't I collect the device directly at the outlet without a two-step coverage validation?
faqs.answer: Dialog Air Fibre operates on the 5G network and service performance can vary by location. A home assessment is performed to identify the optimal router placement, verify indoor Wi-Fi coverage, and confirm that the service can provide reliable connectivity before activation.

faqs.question: What is Air Fibre and how is it different from current 4G Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Air Fibre is a Wi-Fi solution that operates on the Dialog Mobile 5G network. It differs from current 4G Home Broadband because it runs on a 5G network and functions as a mobile-based connection.

faqs.question: Why should I buy Air Fibre? What are the benefits?
faqs.answer: Air Fibre is designed to support smoother experiences such as augmented and virtual reality, lag-free gaming, better-quality streaming including live streaming, and multiple connected devices. Customers can also receive free content subscriptions through the Dialog Play app and exclusive offers.

faqs.question: How can I check if Air Fibre is available at my location?
faqs.answer: You can check Air Fibre availability using Dialog's network coverage map or the MyDialog App.

faqs.question: When will Air Fibre be available in my area if it's not currently covered?
faqs.answer: Air Fibre coverage is being expanded in phases as part of the 5G rollout. The network coverage map will be updated regularly as new areas are added.

faqs.question: Are there any offers for customers to upgrade to Air Fibre?
faqs.answer: Club Vision customers may be eligible for exclusive benefits when subscribing to Dialog Air Fibre. Eligible offers and discounts will be communicated according to Dialog's prevailing eligibility criteria and promotional guidelines.

faqs.question: How can I upgrade my existing Home Wi-Fi connection to Air Fibre?
faqs.answer: You cannot directly upgrade an existing Home Wi-Fi connection to Air Fibre. A new Air Fibre connection is required.

faqs.question: Can I use the Air Fibre device in a non-Air Fibre coverage area?
faqs.answer: Air Fibre is designed for use within designated coverage areas. If the device is moved outside the location validated during installation, 5G service may be limited or unavailable, internet speeds and service performance may be affected, and service quality cannot be guaranteed. For best performance, use the device at the validated installation location.

faqs.question: How long does it take to install Air Fibre?
faqs.answer: Once an order is confirmed, Dialog's technical team will visit the premises within 48 hours to perform the required service assessment. After successful validation, installation and activation will be completed.

faqs.question: If I have not pre-ordered an Air Fibre device, how can I make a new purchase?
faqs.answer: Visit a Dialog Experience Centre, select a preferred monthly plan, make the full payment, and confirm the order. A technical team will visit within 48 hours. If service performance is confirmed, installation and activation will proceed. If 5G coverage is insufficient, installation will not proceed and the full payment will be refunded within 7 working days.

faqs.question: What is the Blaster Fixed Voice Unlimited Package?
faqs.answer: Customers who activate the Unlimited Voice Package for Dialog Wi-Fi routers are eligible for unlimited free calls between Dialog Wi-Fi fixed lines.

faqs.question: Is this available for both Prepaid and Postpaid Dialog Wi-Fi customers?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: Can I use Voice on any Dialog Wi-Fi router?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is applicable for all router models except the P25 and Outdoor models.

faqs.question: Can I change my existing postpaid plan to one of these plans?
faqs.answer: Yes. Download the MyDialog App and select the 'Change Package' option, or dial #678# from your device and select Package Change.

faqs.question: How do I register for e-billing?
faqs.answer: Download the MyDialog App to register, or visit your nearest Dialog outlet.

faqs.question: How do I check my loyalty status?
faqs.answer: Use the MyDialog App to track your Star Points and loyalty points.

faqs.question: How can I manage my Dialog Wi-Fi connection?
faqs.answer: You can manage your Dialog Wi-Fi connection using the MyDialog App, www.dialog.lk, USSD (#678#), or the WhatsApp DIA Bot (777678678).

faqs.question: What features are available in the MyDialog App for Dialog Wi-Fi management?
faqs.answer: The MyDialog App provides data usage monitoring, bill amount and online payment options, package details, available data extensions, and usage history.
features: Bill amount and online payment options

faqs.question: What should I do if the router is not functioning?
faqs.answer: First, restart the router. If it still does not work after restarting, contact the 24/7 Dialog hotline on 117 100 100.
troubleshooting_steps: If the issue continues, contact the Dialog hotline

faqs.question: How can I reconnect a temporarily disconnected Dialog Wi-Fi connection?
faqs.answer: You can reconnect a temporarily disconnected Dialog Wi-Fi connection through the MyDialog App.

faqs.question: How do I check my Dialog TV Bill?
faqs.answer: You can check your Dialog TV bill through the MyDialog App, My Account Portal, by dialing 456, by sending 'Bill [DTV account number]' to 679 from a Dialog mobile connection, or by dialing #147#.
methods: SMS: Bill [DTV account number] to 679 from a Dialog mobile connection

faqs.question: How do I activate/deactivate individual channels by myself?
faqs.answer: You can activate or deactivate individual channels through the My Account Portal, the MyDialog App, or by SMS. From a Dialog Mobile, send 'ON [Dialog Television account number] [channel no]' to 679 to activate, or 'OFF [Dialog Television account number] [channel no]' to 679 to deactivate. From other networks, send the same ON or OFF format to 0770 679 679.

faqs.question: How do I rescan my Dialog TV?
faqs.answer: Keep the decoder switched on. In the MyDialog App, select Dialog TV and choose Rescan. Alternatively, send 'RESCAN [Dialog TV Account number]' to 679 from a Dialog Mobile, or to 0770 679 679 from another mobile network.
methods: MyDialog App: select Dialog TV and click Rescan
SMS from Dialog Mobile: RESCAN [Dialog TV Account number] to 679
SMS from other networks: RESCAN [Dialog TV Account number] to 0770 679 679

faq_groups.title: Account, Balance and Package Management FAQs

faqs.question: How do I check my prepaid mobile balance and remaining data quota?
faqs.answer: To check your prepaid balance, dial #456# or 456 IVR. To check remaining data balance and validity, dial #678# -> Mobile Data Plans -> Check Data Balance, or send an SMS with 'MYUSE' to 678. You can also view real-time graphical usage and balances on the MyDialog App dashboard.
methods: Dial #678# -> Mobile Data Plans -> Check Data Balance

faqs.question: How do I check my postpaid unbilled usage, credit limit, and bill due date?
faqs.answer: Postpaid subscribers can check their outstanding bill, unbilled usage, and credit headroom by dialing #147# or 456, or by opening the 'Bills & Payments' section in the MyDialog App. Your bill cycle dates and exact due dates are also displayed on your monthly e-bill statement.

faqs.question: How do I activate or deactivate a mobile data or voice package?
faqs.answer: To activate packages, open the MyDialog App, dial USSD #678#, or send the package activation keyword via SMS to 678. To deactivate auto-renewing packages, dial #678# -> Option 6 (Subscribed Service List) to view and cancel active services, or cancel auto-renewal under 'Active Plans' in the MyDialog App. Active quotas remain usable until their natural expiry date.

faqs.question: How can I view and unsubscribe from Value-Added Services (VAS)?
faqs.answer: Dial #678# and select Option 6 ('Subscribed Service List') to review all active alerts, ringtones, and recurring VAS charges. From this menu, you can select any active service and deactivate it immediately.
